label: Reliable AI agents
blurb: How do we know an agent is ready for real customers? I build evaluation systems that connect offline simulation, human judgment, and online experiments.

highlight.paper: Building Customer Support AI Agents at 100M-User Scale: An Evaluation-Driven Framework
highlight.contribution: A unified framework for context engineering, prompt optimization, offline evaluation, and production validation across five Nubank deployments.
highlight.result_context: Card-delivery A/B test, compared with prior agent variants.

papers: Screen Before You Serve: Simulation for Production Customer Experience AI Agents at 140M Scale
talks: Building Production LLM Agents: An Evaluation-Driven Playbook
SimulationMaxxing: How we ship agents 20× faster

label: LLM alignment and post-training
blurb: How do reward design and evaluation shape model behavior after pretraining? I study where standard preference-optimization recipes become brittle and how to make alignment more controllable.

highlight.paper: AlphaPO: Reward Shape Matters for LLM Alignment
highlight.contribution: Introduces an alpha-parameterized reward shape that controls likelihood displacement and over-optimization, improving alignment performance over SimPO and DPO across Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B.

papers: On the Robustness of Reward Models for Language Model Alignment

label: Efficient foundation models
blurb: How do we preserve model quality while meeting real training, latency, and serving budgets? I work across distillation, compression, quantization, and systems-aware inference.

highlight.paper: Scaling Down, Serving Fast: Compressing and Deploying Efficient LLMs for Recommendation Systems
highlight.contribution: Distills and compresses production language models with structured pruning and quantization, retaining much of larger-model quality while reducing training and serving cost and latency across recommendation workloads.

papers: Rounding in Preconditioner Space: Redesigning 4-bit AdamW Optimizer-State Quantization
Effective Quantization of Muon Optimizer States
LLM Query Scheduling with Prefix Reuse and Latency Constraints
Efficient Algorithms for Leveraging LLMs for Generative and Predictive Recommender Systems

label: Constrained optimization at scale
blurb: How do we optimize recommendations against global business, allocation, and diversity constraints at web scale? I develop optimization methods that turn model predictions into globally coordinated decisions.

highlight.paper: Practical Design of Performant Recommender Systems using Large-scale Linear Programming-based Global Inference
highlight.contribution: Presents DuaLip, a distributed solver for linear programs with trillions of variables, deployed across LinkedIn recommender systems and released as an extensible open-source library.

papers: A Light-speed Linear Program Solver for Personalized Recommendation with Diversity Constraints
